prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-89763
prose.body:
Hi there,

I hope you're having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-89763 for your recent order with Rowan Catering. The total amount due is 2443.22 USDC.

When you have a moment, please send the payment to our standard wallet address: 0x1a3ae55c66ef72b4cdd83e0807cb201a79e36195. We use this address for all our USDC transactions to keep things simple and secure for our partners like Greywater Robotics.

If you’ve already sent this over, please ignore this note. If you have any questions about the invoice or need a copy resent, just hit reply and I’ll be happy to help.

Thanks so much for choosing Rowan Catering! We truly appreciate your business.

Best regards,
The Rowan Catering Team
